Are you a self-motivated, hands-on individual looking to do something passionate and meaningful with your career? Join us as we open a world of possibilities.

We are currently seeking an **Intake Coordinator/Care Coordinator who is bilingual in English and Spanish** to join our dynamic and growing team!

* Remote - PST Hours

**Who we are:** The Center for Social Dynamics (CSD) is an organization providing services to those with developmental delays, including autism, in the state of California, Oregon, Washington and Hawaii.

CSD’s people and programs deliver personalized, professional, evidence-based behavioral and developmental services to each participant, and peace of mind to caregivers that their loved ones are in the right hands and are receiving the best possible care.

**What is a Intake Coordinator?**

**Intake Coordinators** are responsible for managing the intake and referral process across the organization. They ensure timely and accurate processing of referrals, collect and verify all relevant client and authorization information, and serve as a key point of contact for clinicians, administrative staff, and funding sources. Intake Coordinators monitor the progress of assessments, support scheduling teams with treatment-related details, and maintain accurate documentation in referral and EMR systems. They also contribute to the orientation of new staff, help improve intake systems and processes, and assist with additional administrative tasks as needed to support regional operations.

**What your role is:**

* Processes referrals sent to the organization daily in a timely manner
* Provides Regional Director/Clinician/Admin team with comprehensive intake data within same day of intake being completed to ensure a timely response
* Serves as resource to other staff in the area of intake and triage

* Participates in intake/triage orientation of new staff

* Collects and enters authorization information into EMR system; appropriately assigns CPT and ICD-9 codes when entering authorizations. Follows up with funding sources regarding missing authorizations in a timely manner.
* Reviews assessments for clerical mistakes before sending to the funding source
* Correctly identifies billing and documentation issues which need to be attended to by clinicians and managers and report them in a timely manner
* Answers inquiries from clinicians, clients and funding sources regarding authorizations, treatment/assessment status and services being offered; documents all interactions with clients
* Enters all relevant referral information to referral tracking systems for all referrals sent on a daily basis
* Utilizes referral tracking system to monitor and track referral process and assessment completion
* Tracks intakes requiring urgent attention and communicates difficulties to Regional Director or direct supervisor
* Creates and revises client-intake and treatment systems and processes for all funding sources by analyzing current operating practices and by communicating directly with the funding sources
* Provides detailed information to scheduling, Regional Directors/Manager regarding client timelines to ensure accurate and timely provision of services
* Additional administrative tasks as determined by the needs of the organization.

**What’s required from you?**

* Associate’s degree from an accredited college or university or the equivalent of two years of college coursework at an accredited college or university.
* 3-5 years of ABA intake required
* Bilingual in English and Spanish required
* Experience with CentralReach, Experience with CRM systems, High volume intake processes.
* Computer proficient in word processing, database, spreadsheet and Internet software programs.
* Able to professionally and effectively interact and communicate, verbally and in writing, with volunteers, staff, clients and a public from diverse cultural, socioeconomic, and disciplinary backgrounds. Strong editing skills.
* Able to work independently and as part of a team, take initiative, prioritize and accurately perform multiple tasks, and efficiently meet deadlines and changing priorities.
* Able to consistently demonstrate good judgment and decision-making skills.
* Able to exercise confidentiality and discretion pertaining to the work environment.
* Able to appropriately interpret and apply policies and procedures.
* Familiar with the ABA field.
* Sensitive to working with an ethnically, linguistically, culturally, and economically diverse population.

**Position Overview**

**The Senior Care Manager - Client & Caregiver Relations is a field-facing position** responsible for supporting strong, lasting relationships between clients, caregivers, and the company. The role combines client assessments, caregiver introductions and matching, care coordination, caregiver support and mentoring, quality assurance, problem-solving, conflict resolution, and occasional hands-on caregiving when needed.

This position serves as a key point of contact for clients, families, and caregivers throughout the care relationship. The Senior Care Manager helps identify appropriate care needs, establish successful client-caregiver relationships, monitor the quality and consistency of care, identify concerns early, and communicate findings and recommendations to management.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, communicating with a variety of people, navigating difficult conversations, maintaining professional boundaries, gathering information objectively, recognizing problems, and using sound judgment to determine when an issue requires management involvement or additional outside resources.

* Referrals, appointments, and care transitions are tracked through completion.

new_jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a Clinical Care Coordinator to support patients, families, and care teams through organized, compassionate, and timely coordination of care. This is a fully remote position open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate will help patients navigate appointments, referrals, follow-up care, and communication across providers while maintaining accurate documentation and protecting patient privacy.

This role is well suited for a clinically trained professional who is comfortable working independently, communicating through phone and digital platforms, and balancing multiple patient needs in a fast-moving healthcare environment. Part-time and full-time schedules are available.

Key responsibilities

* Coordinate patient care activities, referrals, appointments, follow-up services, and transitions between care settings.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for patients, caregivers, providers, and internal care teams.
* Conduct outreach to patients to confirm needs, review care plans, identify barriers, and support completion of next steps.
* Review clinical and administrative information to help identify gaps in care, missed follow-ups, or escalating needs.
* Document outreach, care coordination activities, referrals, and outcomes accurately in the EHR or care-management platform.
* Collaborate with physicians, nurses, case managers, social workers, and other members of the care team.
* Support patient education and reinforce care instructions within the scope of training, licensure, and established protocols.
* Escalate urgent, high-risk, or clinically significant concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician or supervisor.
* Track open items and follow through until the appropriate resolution, handoff, or patient connection is completed.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, organizational policies, and applicable federal and state requirements.
* Participate in virtual team meetings, quality-improvement activities, and process updates as needed.

Required qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in clinical care coordination, case management, nursing, patient navigation, utilization management, or a closely related healthcare role.
* RN or comparable healthcare education and experience.
* For roles involving nursing practice, an active, unrestricted RN license in the applicable state(s) is required. Candidates must be able to meet any state-specific licensure requirements associated with their assigned work.
* Experience working with an EHR/EMR, care-management platform, patient portal, or similar healthcare technology.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and empathetically.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently from a home office while remaining responsive and collaborative with a remote team.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and the importance of maintaining confidential patient information.
* Reliable internet connection, private workspace, and ability to use a computer, headset, video-conferencing tools, and common productivity software.

Preferred qualifications

* BSN, MSN, or graduate degree in nursing, social work, public health, healthcare administration, or related field.
* Certifications such as CCM, ACM, CPHQ, or other relevant care management or quality credentials.
* Experience with chronic-care management, behavioral health, transitional care, population health, or value-based care.
* RN, LPN/LVN, or experienced Certified/Registered Medical Assistant, Clinical Care Coordinator – Medicare Care Management (APCM/CCM) - Examples may include an ADN or BSN with an active RN license, or a related degree/credential such as social work, public health, health administration, or allied health with substantial care-coordination experience.
* Experience supporting patients across multiple providers, payers, or healthcare settings.
* Bilingual or multilingual communication skills relevant to the patient population.

Success in this role looks like

* Patients understand their next steps and receive timely follow-ups.
* Referrals, appointments, and care transitions are tracked through completion.
* Documentation is accurate, complete, and entered promptly.
* Care-team members receive clear updates and escalations when needed.
* The coordinator consistently demonstrates empathy, sound judgment, and dependable follow-through.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
2CHealth Solutions is currently looking for a full-time Chronic Care Case Manager to join our growing organization. We specialize in care for patients with chronic diseases. Your primary duty would be to work remotely as a Case Manager. The Case Manager, who works as a Care Coordinator, is a trained healthcare professional who helps to address patients' concerns and manage their chronic diseases through Chronic Care Management (CCM), Principal Care Management (PCM), and Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) programs.

Responsibilities, but not limited to:

* Monitoring and coordinating treatment and care plans.
* Providing care management and coordination services through **CCM, PCM, and RPM** programs.
* Conducting patient outreach, follow-ups, and health assessments as required.
* Educating patients about their disease condition and helping them understand their care plans.
* Monitoring RPM data and identifying changes or concerns that may require follow-up or escalation.
* Connecting patients with healthcare providers, and evaluating their progress.
* Updating patient-related health information, insurance and financial information.
* Ensuring all immediate patient concerns and requests are being addressed.
* Assessing and developing healthcare interventions with the care team.
* Identifying gaps in care and coordinating appropriate follow-up and interventions.
* Documenting patient interactions, care coordination activities, patient enrollments, and encounters accurately and timely.
* Working in collaboration with other healthcare providers and care teams including behavioral health, disease care management, home health care, social work, and community-based organizations as needed.

Qualities of ideal applicant:

* Excellent communication skills
* Problem-solving - take initiative to solve problems that arise
* Well organized with attention to detail
* Time management
* Ability to work as a team member, anticipating providers needs in regards to patient care
* Empathetic with patients' needs and concerns
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment
* Strong documentation and follow-up skills

License, Education and Experience:

* Certified Nursing Assistant with appropriate experience
* Current Medical Assistant-Certified, Medical Healthcare Diploma
* 1 Year of professional experience in the same vicinity
* Experience in **CCM, PCM, RPM, care coordination, or a similar healthcare setting** is preferred
